verdict.rationale: Windmill's own Git sync pushes a commit to an external repository each time an item is deployed, and flows can be defined in YAML. Combined with being open-source and self-hostable, this gives a documented path to take workspace code and definitions elsewhere. But there is no documented export of all data: run history, logs, encrypted variables/secrets and resources are not covered, and no exit or migration procedure is shown. Missing for 10: documented full-workspace export covering all data types (job history, variables, resources), an explicit open export format spec, and hands-on corroboration of leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
